style_tail: Premium original key art for Majarra, an Arabic educational entertainment platform for children aged 3–12. Polished cinematic stylized 3D illustration with soft hand-painted 2D texture, clear single visual concept readable as a small app thumbnail, refined depth and lighting, joyful child-safe culturally inclusive design, deep navy and royal blue foundation with restrained cyan, purple, coral and star-yellow accents. Full-bleed native composition matching the requested aspect ratio, important subjects inside the central safe area. No text, no title, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no interface, no border, no frame, no mockup, no empty title panel, no plaque, no famous or copyrighted characters, no frightening imagery, no weapons, no clutter, no malformed anatomy, no blurred side fill, no letterboxing.
